body.condition: The compact-uniform convergences of the moving-slack remainders are effective: from a rational compact polytope \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\) and a positive rational tolerance, an algorithm returns an index after which \(\max_{j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}}\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\) is below that tolerance.
